# deeplink Provider

Manage short links on a [deeplink](https://github.com/yinebebt/deeplink) server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the deeplink server (e.g. `https://link.example.com`).

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for mutating endpoints. Set in the provider block or via a variable (e.g. `TF_VAR_api_key`).
